swing.description: 0 straight .. 0.5 heavy swing on off-beat steps

symbol.description: Chord symbol, e.g. Cm9, G13, F/A, Bb7#11

anyOf.description: Compact form: "<pitch>:<beats>[!]" tokens played in sequence, e.g. "5:.75! 4:.25 b3:1 r:.5 1+:1/3"

degree.description: 1-based scale degree of the mode; 8 = tonic an octave up

octave.description: Octave offset from the part's register centre

beat.description: Onset offset in beats from motif start (0-based)

low.description: Note name with octave, e.g. C4 (=MIDI 60), F#2, Bb5

high.description: Note name with octave, e.g. C4 (=MIDI 60), F#2, Bb5

grid.description: Steps per beat for step strings (4 = 16ths in 4/4, 3 = triplets)

rhythm.description: Step string; tokens depend on role (see spec)

transforms.description: e.g. transpose:+2, invert, retrograde, displace:+0.5, augment, diminish, octave:+1

repeatEvery.description: Motif repeat period in beats; 0 = once

steps.description: Step string: x hit, X accent, g ghost, . rest; | separates bars

pitch.description: Note name with octave, e.g. C4 (=MIDI 60), F#2, Bb5

message.description: Human-readable; never contains keys or other secrets

provider.description: pi-ai provider id, e.g. anthropic, openai, openrouter, google

ContextOverride.description: null = follow the host (tempo, meter), the score (swing) or the default (key, bars)

partIds.description: Parts this node changed; null = all

text.description: Prompt, or the assistant's reply / answer to a production question

nodeId.description: The lineage node this item produced; its result card

locked.description: Kept as-is by generate, vary and edit

density.description: Density knob; 0.5 = as written. A local transform, not a lineage node

role.description: Only send this role's part from this instance; null = all parts

channel.description: Send everything on this channel; null = each part's own channel

nodeId.description: Node to play; null = the current node

loop.description: Bars to loop; null = the whole clip

freeRun.description: Play on the plugin's own clock while the host is stopped

sublane.description: v1 sublane: kick, snare, clap_rim, hats, toms, cymbals, aux_kit

voices.description: Drums only: GM map for sublane rows and split export

Clip.description: core's realization of a node, for lanes and piano rolls

Usage.description: From the service, never estimated locally

byokEnabled.description: Release flag; read-only for the UI

hasKey.description: A BYOK key is stored for `provider`; the key itself never crosses the bridge back

captureBars.description: Bars of recently played MIDI available to `generate.capture`

redo.description: Node ids undone from currentNodeId, most recent last

SavedSession.description: Plugin state (getStateInformation). No keys, no provider credentials.

count.description: Variations to plan in parallel; each becomes a node

amount.description: register: octaves; transpose: semitones; humanize: 0..1; others: null

remove.description: Notes as they appear in the current clip

key.description: null = delete. Goes straight to the OS keychain; never logged or saved

nodeId.description: null = the current node (a thread card can drag its own node)

requestId.description: Set when the command started a model request

session.description: Set on hello and on any command that changed the session

nodeIds.description: One per variation; empty when the reply was text only

keep.description: Locked parts (and harmony) to plan around; null = fresh plan

partIds.description: Parts the edit may change; locked parts are excluded

text.description: For the thread: a short note on the result, or the answer to a question

score.description: null when the request was answered with text only
